words.fa: مهاجر (کسی که وارد کشور دیگری می‌شود تا آنجا زندگی کند)
words.en: a person who comes to live permanently in a foreign country
words.example: Many immigrants move to Canada to find better jobs.
words.exampleFa: بسیاری از مهاجران برای پیدا کردن کار بهتر به کانادا می‌روند.

words.fa: مهاجرت کردن (از کشور خودت به جای دیگر)
words.en: to leave your own country to live in another one
words.example: My cousin decided to emigrate to Germany last year.
words.exampleFa: پسرعمویم پارسال تصمیم گرفت به آلمان مهاجرت کند.

words.en: a person who legally belongs to a country
words.example: You must live here for five years before you can become a citizen.
words.exampleFa: باید پنج سال اینجا زندگی کنی تا بتوانی شهروند شوی.

words.en: the legal right to belong to a country
words.example: She received citizenship after ten years in the country.
words.exampleFa: او بعد از ده سال زندگی در این کشور تابعیت گرفت.

words.en: an official document that allows you to enter or stay in a country
words.example: I need a student visa to study in the UK.
words.exampleFa: برای تحصیل در انگلستان به ویزای دانشجویی نیاز دارم.

words.en: an official document you need to travel to other countries
words.example: Don't forget to bring your passport to the interview.
words.exampleFa: یادت نره گذرنامه‌ات رو به مصاحبه بیاری.

words.en: the line that separates two countries
words.example: We waited two hours at the border.
words.exampleFa: دو ساعت در مرز منتظر ماندیم.

words.en: official permission to live in a country for a period of time
words.example: He renewed his residence permit before it expired.
words.exampleFa: او اجازه‌ی اقامتش را قبل از تمام شدن اعتبارش تمدید کرد.

words.en: official permission to work in a country
words.example: Without a work permit, you can't legally get a job here.
words.exampleFa: بدون مجوز کار نمی‌توانی به‌طور قانونی اینجا شغل بگیری.

words.en: to ask officially for something, usually in writing
words.example: I'm going to apply for a scholarship next month.
words.exampleFa: ماه بعد برای بورسیه اقدام می‌کنم.

words.en: a formal request for something, such as a visa or a job
words.example: The application form takes about an hour to fill in.
words.exampleFa: پر کردن فرم درخواست حدود یک ساعت طول می‌کشد.

words.en: the latest time or date by which something must be done
words.example: The deadline for sending the documents is March 1st.
words.exampleFa: مهلت ارسال مدارک اول مارس است.

words.en: something that you must have or do
words.example: A language certificate is a basic requirement for this visa.
words.exampleFa: مدرک زبان شرط اصلی این ویزاست.

words.en: a person who has to leave their country because of war or danger
words.example: Thousands of refugees crossed the border last winter.
words.exampleFa: هزاران پناهنده زمستان گذشته از مرز عبور کردند.

words.en: protection given by a country to people who have left their own country because of danger
words.example: He asked for asylum because it was not safe in his country.
words.exampleFa: او چون در کشورش امنیت نداشت درخواست پناهندگی کرد.

words.en: money given to a student to help pay for their education
words.example: She won a scholarship to study in the Netherlands.
words.exampleFa: او بورسیه‌ی تحصیل در هلند را برنده شد.

words.en: the money you pay to a university or school for teaching
words.example: The tuition fee is lower for students from some countries.
words.exampleFa: شهریه برای دانشجویان بعضی کشورها کمتر است.

words.en: a place to live or stay
words.example: Finding cheap accommodation in a big city is difficult.
words.exampleFa: پیدا کردن جای ارزان در شهر بزرگ سخت است.

words.en: the official building of a foreign government in a country
words.example: I have an appointment at the embassy on Monday.
words.exampleFa: دوشنبه در سفارت وقت دارم.

words.en: a formal meeting where someone asks you questions
words.example: The visa interview was shorter than I expected.
words.exampleFa: مصاحبه‌ی ویزا کوتاه‌تر از چیزی بود که انتظار داشتم.

words.en: to start living in a place permanently and feel comfortable there
words.example: It took them a year to settle in their new city.
words.exampleFa: یک سال طول کشید تا در شهر جدیدشان مستقر شوند.

words.en: in or to a foreign country
words.example: Many young people dream of working abroad.
words.exampleFa: بسیاری از جوان‌ها آرزوی کار در خارج از کشور را دارند.

words.en: to become a full member of a group or community
words.example: Learning the language helps you integrate into society.
words.exampleFa: یادگیری زبان به جذب شدن در جامعه کمک می‌کند.

words.en: sad because you are away from home
words.example: I felt homesick during my first winter abroad.
words.exampleFa: در اولین زمستانم در خارج از کشور دلتنگ وطن بودم.

words.en: the confused feeling you get in a country with a very different way of life
words.example: Culture shock can be strong in the first few weeks.
words.exampleFa: شوک فرهنگی در چند هفته‌ی اول می‌تواند شدید باشد.
